input: Is there anything on LLZ beyond MAUDE — recalls or literature?

sentences.text: The newest LLZ recall, Z-0186-2027, was initiated by INTELERAD MEDICAL SYSTEMS INCORPORATED and cites K192176.
Its stated reason is that "report and displayed images may not match".

claims.quote: report and displayed images may not match

sentences.text: PMID 38269880 (2024) built classifiers to find machine-learning safety events in MAUDE; it is context, not evidence about a specific report.

input: Why did reports for LLZ jump in the last week of August?

sentences.text: The stored LLZ reports run to 2026-08-31, so the last week of August is 2026-08-25 to 2026-08-31: LLZ received 33 reports in that week.
